name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
summary: An Alliance Brigadier General asks you to bring Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor. The marks are needed outside the battlegrounds.

sections.title: The Marks
sections.body: After fighting in Warsong Gulch, you can bring three Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds. The general asks for the marks, and you know what must be brought to them.

faq.q: What does the brigadier general want?
faq.answer: An Alliance Brigadier General asks you to bring three Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor.

faq.q: Where do I bring the marks?
faq.answer: Bring the marks to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

faq.q: How many Marks of Honor are needed?
faq.answer: The general asks for three Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can bring the Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General.

attribution: In-game quest text: Fight for Warsong Gulch
